en.html:
...Inside a house.
A farmhouse, perhaps.

Unfamiliar floor, unfamiliar bedding. Here I had been laid. To speak plainly, very hard. Warm, though. That much could be said in its favor.

I became aware of my body. Bandages around the chest, apparently. Wrapped rather tightly. Not the arrangement for a bruise. More likely the arrangement after considerable bleeding.

Achha.
When and where had I acquired an injury like that—

……家の中だ。

されている。
　<ruby>有体<rt>ありてい</rt></ruby>に言って、ひどく硬い。だが温かくはあった。

　己の全身を知覚する。

締めてある。打撲傷ではなく、おそらく激しい出血を
した際の巻き方。

　さて。
　そのような負傷をいつ、何処で――

The girl stood and ran to the chest of drawers. The man who sat down in her place looked over my whole body with quiet eyes. Stuck to his back, another girl peeped out, perhaps three or four years younger than the first.

Our eyes met. She gave me a shy smile.

I had no procedure prepared for this.

Funa"Ooooh!"
Yagenta"...See. A severe open wound when I brought him here. Already new flesh is covering it. A warrior's recovery is a formidable thing."
Fuki"H-how...?"
Yagenta"That is the power of a real tsurugi. Not an imitation. It carries the body and soul of its smith; breaking such a thing is not easy. A little damage, and it restores itself without difficulty."
Yagenta"And the warrior joined to it by the Tatewaki rite is always one with it. The power of restoration reaches the warrior's body also. Here, you can see."
Fuki"So that's how... Amazing..."
Kageaki"Even so. Without your help, I would have been killed before recovery could take place. My thanks are still due."
Yagenta"The magistrate and his hangers-on will not be the end of you. That is not your destiny. Besides, Mido, I did only what was natural."
Kageaki"..."
Yagenta"When you stopped that fool at the worksite on the mountain, I was there. Now I find the village's savior lying helpless. Am I to stand there and do nothing?"
Kageaki"Personal reasons led to my action. Being called a savior puts me in considerable discomfort."
Yagenta"So be uncomfortable, but when people receive help, they give thanks. Natural enough, no?"
Kageaki"..."

弥源太「……見よ。 　ここへ連れて来た時は骨が覗いておったが な。既に肉が盛り上がり、傷を覆っている。 　まこと、武者の回復力は凄まじい」
ふき「ど、どうして……？」
弥源太「これが紛い物にあらざる劔冑の力。 　鍛冶師の身魂を宿す真の劔冑はなまなかな ことでは破壊されぬ。少々の欠損なら自力で 容易く復元してのける」
弥源太「そして、帯刀タテワキの儀によって結縁した武者と 劔冑は常に一体……。 　復元の力は武者の肉体にも及ぶのだ。この ようにな」
ふき「そうなんだ……。 　すごい……」
景明「さりながら。 　貴方がたがお助けくださらなければ、回復 するより前に命を絶たれていたことでしょう。 やはり御礼は申し上げねばなりません」
弥源太「なれは代官だのその取巻きだのに殺される ような天命ほしではないよ。 　それに御堂、うては当然のことをしている に過ぎん」

景明「それは一身上の都合でした事。 　救いなどと考えられては身が縮みます」
弥源太「だとしても助けられれば感謝はするもの。 　当然のことであろう？」
景明「……」

Emishi did not visibly age; by appearance alone, he could have been in the prime of life. But the weight in his movements, and his use of Mido, suggested his real years.

Mido. An old form of address for warriors, not much used now. It came from the Shakutendo, the building that had once housed the court's warriors' hall.

古風な敬称。

Yagenta"Police, then?"
Kageaki"Thank you for your cooperation. I shall repay this kindness at a later date..."
Kageaki"For today, I should take my leave shortly."
Fuki"Eh!? No, you can't! How will you go like this?"
Yagenta"...I praised the speed of your recovery, yes. Still, one night at least before you can move. Force it and the wound opens again."
Kageaki"But I cannot impose. Staying here, I do not merely occupy space with this body—"
Yagenta"The magistrate's men, is it? Haan, so that wound came from fighting them. You think pursuers may arrive."
Kageaki"Precisely."
Yagenta"Unnecessary worry. Throw you out, and those men stop being a nuisance to us? Is that the arrangement?"
Kageaki"That is..."
Yagenta"They are here, so the village has trouble. Personal reasons or any other reasons, Mido, if you mean to deal with them, helping you is good for the village."
Kageaki"..."
Yagenta"Rest here one full day. For you, that should probably be enough to recover completely."
Fuki"Please do. I don't understand all these difficult things, but someone this badly hurt walking out—nahin. That's not allowed."
Funa"Hmm? Didi, what happened to Bhaiya?"
Fuki"Bhaiya says he wants to go home."
Funa"Nooo! I don't want that! Stay more, na..."
Fuki"See? Warrior sahib, Funa is saying it also."

弥源太「警察の人であったか」
景明「御協力に感謝致します。 　この御礼は後日必ず……」
景明「今日のところは、そろそろ失礼させて頂き ます」
ふき「えっ!? 　そんな……無理ですよ！」
弥源太「……さっきは回復が早いと褒めたがな。 　流石に一晩は動けんだろうよ。無理をして 動けばまた傷口が開くぞ」
景明「しかし、ご迷惑は掛けられません。 　自分がここに留まれば、この図体で場所を 塞ぐのみならず――」
弥源太「代官どものことを案じておるのか？ 　なるほど……やはりその傷はやつらと一戦 交えた結果か。それで追手が来るかもしれぬ と言うのだな」
景明「まさしく」
弥源太「だがそれは無用の心配。 　ここでなれを追い出したところで、やつら の迷惑が迷惑でなくなるものか」
景明「それは……」
弥源太「やつらはいる限り村の迷惑よ。 　一身上の都合だろうが何だろうが、御堂、 なれがやつらを成敗するというのなら、なれ を助けることは村の利益に適う」
景明「……」
弥源太「丸一日はここで休んでゆけ。 　なれならば、おそらくそれで全快しよう」
ふき「そうしてください。 　あては難しいことはわかりませんけど…… こんな大怪我をしている人が出ていくなんて、 そんなの駄目です」
ふな「んーっ？ 　ねーや、にーやはどうしたの？」
ふき「にーや、おうちに帰りたいんだって」
ふな「えーっ、そんなのやだ！ 　もっといてほしい……」
ふき「そうよねっ。 　ほら、お武家様。ふなもこう言ってます」

...Still, I could not see myself resisting this and leaving.

And Yagenta was right. Force myself out now—where was the benefit, where was the sense? Accepting their kindness appeared to be the wiser course.
